newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude dips in thin U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude dips in thin U.S. paper trading.

text.p: Benchmark Brent crude oil dipped in thin U.S. paper trading late on Tuesday, traders said.
Activity was subdued for a second consecutive day leading up to Friday's U.S. Independence Day holiday.
Partial August Brent cargoes switched hands at $18.76, $18.78 and $18.79 a barrel, compared to the IPE settlement of 18.82.
August/September Brent traded at minus four cents, a shade weaker than afternoon talk in London.
